about: Copilot permission prompts whose intention tries to turn the command, or itself, into Markdown (#212). message is exactly what a host sends (CopilotPermission); every client must draw the intention as the words they are and the command (or file and diff) as code. Read by tests/AgentBridge.Host.Core.Tests, tests/AgentBridge.App.Tests and pwa/test/unit.
